name: Parameter Completeness
description: Read-only fill rate per category and parameter (optionally per level) from a saved snapshot, with optional CSV and HTML heatmap files in the workspace.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: Saved snapshot to measure. Required when connected to Revit.

parameters.description: Parameter names to measure. Leave empty to use the most common parameters per category.

top_n.description: With no parameters listed: how many of the most common parameters to take per category (1 to 50).

categories.description: Only these categories, for example OST_Doors.

by_level.description: Split each fill rate by level.

max_rows.description: Rows returned in the result; the CSV and HTML files always hold every row.

csv_filename.description: Optional .csv file name inside the workspace.

html_filename.description: Optional .html file name inside the workspace (self-contained heatmap).
